question: The Chief Minister of which of the following states launched the second phase of Ladli Laxmi Scheme 2.0 in November 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Madhya Pradesh.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the second phase of Ladli Laxmi Scheme 2.0 in November 2022.**
 
• **The Ladli Laxmi Scheme is a welfare scheme for the girl child.**
 
• It aims to provide financial assistance to families for the education and marriage of their daughters.
 
• The scheme was first launched in **Madhya Pradesh in 2007** and has since been expanded and improved over the years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Uttar Pradesh, Andhra Pradesh, and Bihar** are also states in India that have implemented similar schemes for the** welfare of the girl child.**
 
• **Uttar Pradesh has the Kanya Sumangala Yojana, Andhra Pradesh has the Amma Vodi scheme, and Bihar has the Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan Yojana.**
 
• The Ladli Laxmi Scheme in Madhya Pradesh provides financial assistance to families in the form of a fixed deposit that matures when the girl turns 18.
 
• **The amount of the deposit varies depending on the income of the family and the age of the girl.**
